project_context.mechanism: URL path segment /production/:projectSlug/{design|experience|expression}; chrome projectIdFromPath() and ProductionAuthorityFrame.projectSlugFromPath() fall back to 'ndxbook' for /production, /queue, /libraries, /activity. ProductionWorkspaceContext persists projectSlug to storage but the chrome/data provider never read it. Switcher = listHostProductionProjects() (managed registry minus site00) → projectSwitchPath keeps workspace+design mode. Hub machine has a second independent reducer-based selector initialised to 'ndxbook'.

client_status_integration.in_production_workspace: NONE — no send-to-client action, no AWAITING_CLIENT/APPROVED-by-client status, no read of client review data anywhere under /production
client_status_integration.client_review_system: shared/site00-client-reviews/types.ts ClientReviewStatus READY_FOR_REVIEW|AWAITING_CLIENT|REVISION_IN_PROGRESS|APPROVED|DECLINED|SUPERSEDED|LOCKED; api/site00/client-reviews.ts GET queue/detail/appDetail/adminFeedback, POST comment/annotation/approve/revision/decline/revisit — client-side actions only; NO operator create/publish action. Only writer of site00_client_review_objects is api/_lib/site00ClientReviews/previewFixtureSeed.ts.
client_status_integration.admin_side: api/_lib/site00Production: DeliverableStatus has CLIENT_REVIEW/CLIENT_APPROVED and controlCommand/clientStudio read site00_approval_requests status CLIENT_REVIEW|READY_FOR_CLIENT, but nothing writes those statuses (decideApproval writes APPROVED_INTERNALLY|REVISION).
client_status_integration.verdict: send-to-client: MISSING; awaiting: MISSING (read model exists server-side, no writer); approved: client can approve fixture reviews only; result never flows back to production INBOX/ACTIVITY
